questions.question_text: Sahajanand Namavali māṁ paheluṁ nām kaḷuṁ chhe?
questions.explanation: The first name in the Sahajanand Namavali is 'Om Shri Swāminārāyaṇāya Namah'.

questions.question_text: Sahajanand Namavali māṁ 40-muṁ nām kaḷuṁ chhe?
questions.explanation: The 40th name in the Sahajanand Namavali is 'Om Shri Sahajānandāya Namah'.

questions.question_text: Sahajanand Namavali māṁ 109-muṁ nām kaḷuṁ chhe?
questions.explanation: The 109th name in the Sahajanand Namavali is 'Om Shri Aksharapuruṣhottama-Mahārājāya Namah'.

questions.question_text: Sahajanand Namavali māṁ kḷuṁ nām 'Sarvāvatāra-Kāraṇāya' taḷke darshāveḷuṁ chhe?
questions.explanation: The name 'Om Shri Sarvāvatāra-Kāraṇāya Namah' (31) means the cause of all avatars.

questions.question_text: Sahajanand Namavali māṁ kḷuṁ nām 'Shāshvata-Shānti-Dāyakāya' taḷke darshāveḷuṁ chhe?
questions.explanation: The name 'Om Shri Shāshvata-Shānti-Dāyakāya Namah' (54) means the giver of eternal peace.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.72 pramāṇe, je bhagwānnā bhaktane bhagwānno nishchay māhātmya sahit hoy ne santnu ne satsangīnu māhātmya ghaṇu jāṇto hoy, ne te bhaktnu jo karma kaṭhaṇ hoy ne kāḷ paṇ kaṭhaṇ hoy to paṇ te bhaktane evī bhaktinu atishay baḷ chhe, te __________ e bey maḷīne tenu bhūnḍu karī shaktā nathī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states that 'te kāḷ ne karma e bey maḷīne tenu bhūnḍu karī shaktā nathī'.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Pr.72 pramāṇe, bhagwānnā bhaktane kaḷuṁ baḷ prāpt thāḷ chhe jeṭhī kaṭhaṇ kāḷ ne karma paṇ tenu bhūnḍu karī shaktā nathī?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, 'te bhaktane evī bhaktinu atishay baḷ chhe'.

questions.question_text: Swa.Vato.5/250 pramāṇe, "Moṭā lagār paṇ draṣhṭi kare to kāmādik __________."
questions.explanation: The Swamini Vato states, 'Moṭā lagār paṇ draṣhṭi kare to kāmādik pīḍī shake nahī'.

questions.question_text: Swa.Vato.5/250 māṁ Moṭāno draḍh āsharo karavānuṁ shaṇ māṭe kahevāmāṁ āveḷuṁ chhe?
options: potānī meḷe game teṭalā dākhaḍā kare paṇ kāmādik parābhav karyā vinā rahe ja nahī
questions.correct_answer: potānī meḷe game teṭalā dākhaḍā kare paṇ kāmādik parābhav karyā vinā rahe ja nahī
questions.explanation: The Swamini Vato advises 'Māṭe Moṭāno draḍh āsharo karavo' because 'potānī meḷe game teṭalā dākhaḍā kare paṇ kāmādik parābhav karyā vinā rahe ja nahī'.

questions.question_text: Sahajanand Namavali māṁ nām ā pramāṇe chhe: "Om Shri __________-____________-Pradāyakāya Namah".
questions.explanation: The full name is 'Om Shri Svāminārāyaṇetyākhya-Divyamantra-Pradāyakāya Namah' (88).
